definition: Total fertility rate from Kosovo Multiple Indicator Cluster Surveys (MICS), by ethnicity of the household. Roma, Ashkali and Egyptian communities are grouped in the newest round.
source: Kosovo MICS (UNICEF / ASK) — 2013–14, 2019–20, and 2023–25 rounds (BirthGauge summary of the newest survey).
headline: Total fertility rate by ethnicity (MICS)
note: Sample size was too small to publish a Serb TFR in the newest round. Ethnicity categories are survey definitions, not vital-registration ancestry.
